findings.label: Exit price from plugin-side cur_stop
findings.detail: _closed rebuilds a moved-stop exit from info.cur_stop. If the plugin's view lags the broker (restart between broker accept and snapshot, or a stop_loosen showing the broker is tighter), the trade row records the wrong exit. Before going live, use the broker's fill price for stop exits when available, or resync on stop_loosen (core proposal 3).

findings.label: bracket_reference: signal_close is a weak fit
findings.detail: 249/959 rows match the sim and results run about +$2.35/trade above the research. Defaults to off and is documented as evaluation-only. Revert 0276523 if it should not ship; otherwise keep it out of presets.
